description: The catalogue of formalised law: instruments, predicates with signatures, the boundaries of coverage. This is where the NAMES of predicates come from — they must never be guessed. But do NOT start from the catalogue when looking for the right instrument: the overview is large, and the title of an instrument rarely matches the words of a question ("Newton's laws of motion" contains no word "physics"). A question in your own words goes to law_search first, which returns addresses; the catalogue is for the exact signature of what you found. With no arguments — the overview: one line per instrument (key, title, legal order, counters of rules, facts, signatures, norms, constants); a whole instrument — package="kz-gpk"; a search over the signatures, labels and constants of every instrument — query="substring". All three modes are PAGED: limit and offset, with the remainder named in the text (`showing a–b of N; k more`) and in structuredContent (total, truncated, next — a ready-made continuation call). The unit of a page is named by pageUnit: the overview and query page over INSTRUMENTS (20 and 20 by default), package=… pages over the SIGNATURES of one instrument (20 by default, 300 at most) — large codes carry thousands. package=… together with catalog=… pages a separate list of the instrument: "questions" — the CATALOGUE OF QUESTIONS (DECISION-0190): which enquiries are provided for (a question in words, a form, a predicate or norms) and what the instrument does NOT answer, with the type of reason; a card is a template of an enquiry, not an answer, and not every instrument has one; "norms" — the NORMS of the instrument (modality §107 and label), "constants" — the CONSTANTS (names of declarations). "task-guides" — TASK GUIDES (DECISION-0414): the order of applying a canon to a document — what to gather, which cards to ask and how to read the answers; a guide answers nothing. catalog="task-guides" is allowed without package too — every guide of the profile; guide=… — the detail of one guide; the walkthrough — MCP Prompts under the same name. The detail of an instrument prints a preview of these lists and names the count and the ready-made call for the mode.

catalog.description: together with package: page the catalogue of questions, the norms, the constants or the task guides of the instrument instead of its signatures; "task-guides" also without package: every task guide of the profile

guide.description: together with catalog="task-guides": the detail of one guide — a name <package>/<id> (as in prompts/list) or an id together with package

limit.description: how many per page: instruments (overview 20, query 20), signatures of an instrument (20, at most 300) or elements of a catalog list (questions 20, norms 20, constants 100, task guides 20)

offset.description: from which element of the page (0); the unit is the pageUnit of the answer

package.description: the full signatures of this instrument

query.description: a substring filter over signatures, labels and constants (case-insensitive)

name: law_packages
